{
  "function": "() => {
  // Extract all listing items on the page
  const rows = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('tr, div[data-testid*="row"], .table-row'));
  const items = [];
  
  // Find all SKU links
  const skuLinks = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('a[href*="/skucentral?mSku="]'));
  
  for (const a of skuLinks) {
    const sku = a.innerText.trim();
    // Get row or container
    let p = a;
    for (let i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
      if (p.parentElement) p = p.parentElement;
    }
    const txt = p.innerText.replace(/\s+/g, ' ');
    const asinMatch = p.querySelector('a[href*="/dp/"]')?.href?.match(/dp\/([A-Z0-9]+)/)?.[1] || 
                      txt.match(/ASIN:\s*([A-Z0-9]+)/)?.[1] || 
                      txt.match(/B0[0-9A-Z]{8}/)?.[0] || 'N/A';
    const titleMatch = p.querySelector('a[href*="/dp/"]')?.innerText?.trim() || 'N/A';
    const statusMatch = txt.match(/不可售[^\s]*|缺少报价|报价缺失|Inactive[^\s]*/)?.[0] || '缺少报价';
    
    items.push({
      sku,
      asin: asinMatch,
      title: titleMatch.slice(0, 100),
      status: statusMatch
    });
  }
  
  // Also get the status dropdown selected text
  const selectedStatus = document.querySelector('kat-dropdown [part*="selected"], kat-dropdown [slot*="selected-option"]')?.innerText?.trim();
  
  return {
    totalItemsOnPage: items.length,
    selectedStatus,
    items: items.slice(0, 10)
  };
}",
  "pageId": 17,
  "waitForStableDom": false
}
